name: Quillback Ravager
description: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

abilities.name: Barbed Hide
abilities.description: When a creature succeeds on an action roll to Grapple or physically Restrain the Ravager, they take 1d8+2 physical damage. The Grapple or Restrained effect still succeeds. The Ravager’s backward-facing quills drive into anyone who tries to hold it.

abilities.name: Quill Fan
abilities.description: Make an attack against all targets in front of the Ravager within Close range. Targets the Ravager succeeds against take 2d6+3 physical damage. The Ravager arches its back and releases a wide spray of jagged quills.

abilities.name: Crushing Pummel
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10+5 physical damage and knock the target back to Very Close range. The Ravager lowers its quills and batters the target with both massive fists.
